decisions.quote: The second and third columns of Figure 1 documents the robustness of Bloom’s (2009) results to employing these alternative proxies for uncertainty.
decisions.reason: Beyond reproducing the baseline linear VAR numbers on the original sample, the authors re-estimate the VAR using alternative uncensored (unfiltered and HP-filtered) volatility proxies as well as a nonlinear STVAR framework and explicitly conclude that Bloom's (2009) results are robust.
